system.description:
You create a single high-pressure stream of air from either your hands or feet slowing your descent while falling by 60 feet per round until the jutsu ends. If you land before the ninjutsu ends, you take no falling damage and land on your feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and select 2 additional willing creatures for this Jutsu’s benefits within 30 feet of you.
